rules.expr: [this == null ? root : this].all(r, r.workload.driver_type in ["postgres", "mysql", "noop"] || r.workload.segments.all(s, !(s.workload.script in ["tpcc/procs", "tpcb/procs"])))
rules.message: stored-procedure workloads require PostgreSQL, MySQL or noop driver

rules.expr: [this == null ? root : this].all(r, r.workload.driver_type != "ydb" || r.workload.segments.all(s, s.workload.script != "tpcds" || ((! ("query_stream" in s.workload) || s.workload.query_stream == null) && (!("streams" in s.workload) || s.workload.streams == 1))))

rules.expr: [this == null ? root : this].all(r, r.workload.driver_type != "picodata" || r.workload.segments.all(s, s.workload.script != "tpcds" || ("no_steps" in s && "workload" in s.no_steps) || ("steps" in s && size(s.steps) > 0 && !("workload" in s.steps))))
rules.message: Picodata TPC-DS supports loading only; exclude the workload step

rules.expr: [this == null ? root : this].all(r, !("driver" in r.workload) || !("caCertFile" in r.workload.driver) || !("ca_cert" in r.workload))
rules.message: choose a CA file or inline CA certificate

rules.expr: [this == null ? root : this].all(r, !("scrapes" in r) || r.scrapes.all(s, "containers" in r && r.containers.exists(c, c.name == s.job && c.role == s.role)))

rules.expr: [this == null ? root : this].all(r, !("scrapes" in r) || r.scrapes.all(s, r.scrapes.filter(x, x.job == s.job && x.role == s.role).size() == 1))
rules.message: scrape targets must be unique

rules.expr: [this == null ? root : this].all(r, !("containers" in r) || r.containers.all(c, !("scrape" in c) || "scrape_port" in c || ("ports" in c && size(c.ports) > 0)))

rules.expr: [this == null ? root : this].all(r, !("containers" in r) || r.containers.all(c, !("depends_on" in c) || c.depends_on.all(d, d != c.name && d in r.containers.map(x, x.name))))

fields.name: run

fields.description: Scenario executor: constant-vus runs for a duration, shared-iterations shares N iterations between VUs.

fields.description: Concurrent virtual users (vus); sizes the runner machine and the pool.
fields.title: Virtual users

fields.title: Duration

fields.name: iterations

rules.expr: this.executor != "constant-vus" || ("duration" in this && this.duration != null)
rules.message: constant-vus needs a duration

rules.expr: this.executor != "constant-vus" || !("iterations" in this) || this.iterations == null
rules.message: iterations applies only to shared-iterations

rules.expr: this.executor != "shared-iterations" || !("duration" in this) || this.duration == null
rules.message: duration applies only to constant-vus

rules.expr: this.executor != "shared-iterations" || ("iterations" in this && this.iterations != null)
rules.message: shared-iterations needs an iteration count

fields.title: Scenario

fields.name: steps
fields.description: Run only the listed stroppy steps (--steps); empty = all steps.
fields.title: Only these steps

fields.name: no_steps
fields.description: Skip the listed stroppy steps (--no-steps); stroppy rejects it together with steps.
fields.title: Skip these steps

fields.name: extra_params
fields.description: Typed stroppy flags this form does not model, by flag name without dashes (load-workers); values are parsed by stroppy.

rules.expr: this.all(k, k.matches("^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$"))
rules.message: extra parameter keys must be stroppy flag names (lower-kebab)

fields.title: Extra parameters

fields.name: files
fields.description: Extra files (SQL dialects, schemas, data) shipped with the segment.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name the file gets in the segment workspace; reference it from sql_file/schema_file.
fields.title: File name

fields.name: kind
fields.description: What the file is: a schema/DDL file, a config, or a data file.
fields.title: Kind

fields.name: content
fields.description: Inline file body, at most 1 MiB.
fields.title: Content

fields.name: ref
fields.description: Graphene artifact reference in the current namespace, artifact/<name>; fetched on the runner.
fields.title: Reference

rules.expr: ("content" in this) != ("ref" in this)
rules.message: a file needs exactly one of content or ref

fields.title: Files

fields.name: thresholds
fields.description: Pass/fail bounds the pipeline applies to the segment summary.

fields.name: p99_ms
fields.description: Fail the segment when iteration_duration p99 exceeds this.
fields.title: p99 latency

fields.name: error_rate
fields.description: Fail the segment when failed_iterations / iterations exceeds this (0..1).
fields.title: Error rate
Thresholds

fields.name: seed
fields.description: Stroppy global.seed; zero uses Stroppy's random seed, a positive value makes generation reproducible.
fields.title: Random seed

fields.name: timeout
fields.description: Execution deadline after the warmup wait, including container preparation and data load; unset uses duration plus headroom, or 24h for iterations.
fields.title: Segment timeout

fields.name: warmup
fields.description: Idle wait before the segment starts, letting caches and replicas settle.
fields.title: Warm-up

fields.name: log_level
fields.description: Minimum stroppy log level (--log-level); debug traces parameter resolution.
fields.title: Log level

yandex_settings.description: Yandex Cloud placement settings of a tenant provider profile (no secrets).

fields.name: cloud_id
fields.description: Yandex Cloud cloud id owning the folder.
fields.title: Cloud id

fields.name: folder_id
fields.description: Folder every VM, disk and network of a run is created in.
fields.title: Folder id

fields.name: zone
fields.description: Availability zone of ru-central1 the run is placed in.
fields.title: Zone

fields.name: zones
fields.description: Three physical zones for multi-zone topologies. When omitted, use zone and two other catalog zones. Single-zone topologies use zone.
fields.title: Distributed topology zones

fields.name: platform_id
fields.description: Compute platform (CPU generation) the machines are created on.
fields.title: Platform

fields.name: network
fields.description: Create a throwaway network for every run, or place runs into an existing one.

fields.name: subnet_cidr
fields.description: IPv4 range of the subnet created for the run.
fields.title: Subnet CIDR

fields.name: network_id
fields.description: Existing VPC network the machines join.
fields.title: Network id

fields.name: subnet_id
fields.description: Existing subnet in the chosen zone.
fields.title: Subnet id

fields.name: security_group_id
fields.description: Existing security group applied to every machine.
fields.title: Security group id
Network

fields.name: public_ips
fields.description: Assign a one-to-one NAT public address to every machine.
fields.title: Public IPs

fields.name: image_family
fields.description: Boot image family from the standard-images folder.
fields.title: Image family

fields.name: preemptible
fields.description: Use preemptible VMs: much cheaper, but stopped after 24h or under pressure — do not use for a measurement that must complete.
fields.title: Preemptible

rules.expr: [this == null ? root : this].all(s, !("network" in s) || s.network.kind == "create")
rules.message: existing networks are not implemented by the pipeline; use a run-owned network
